parse_text: HELLEBORUS, HELLEBORR, in botany, a genus of the polyandria polygynia clafs. I has an cally, the pe- rais are five or more; the reclaim is tubular and blue biarded; and the capital contains many feeds. There are five species, two of them native of Britain, viz. the females, or great balham black hellebore; and the visida, or wild black hellebore. The hellebors, when taken in large quantities, is polinous; but the root, in final dates, is fuppeded to attenuate the humours, and to promote urinary and uterine discharge.
